{{Otheruses|Vessel}}
A '''Vessel''' was a type of [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] that could store vast amounts of information in their heads, without being able to access it. In legal usage, vessels were simply a form of courier, delivering information to a location at which point the information was removed. Vessels were required to spend a certain period of time as an indentured servant&mdash;at least a decade&mdash;normally for the corporation that paid for their operation.<ref name="GG2nd">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> They were usually strong and well trained so they could protect the information they were carrying. An independent vessel could earn 1000&ndash;10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per mission. One type of implant used by vessels was the [[Swift 78B Vessel Courier System]].<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>
